q: How many trunks on a premises location?
a: One. The same trunk may serve many locations.

q: What does a dial plan point at?
a: A trunk or a route group, with patterns for on-premises destinations. Plans are enterprise-wide.

q: Certificate trunk port versus registration trunk port?
a: TCP 5062 for certificate-based, TCP 8934 for registration-based.
